style: Painterly cinematic realism, like a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world: tarred wood, salt-dulled brass, glass bottles and paper. Company order reads as ink-blue, ledger red, tea brown and flat lamp-white light from above; the wild sea as sea-green, foam, storm violet and low dawn gold from the left. Alexi is always seen from behind, his face not shown; never a body, a trident, a crown or a halo. The engraved line is added afterwards by code, not by the image model.

images.title: The boat on the wave, between the ordered sea and the wild
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. A small old single-masted wooden sailing boat climbs the face of one great sea-green wave. At the tiller, seen from behind, a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers, one hand raised and turning in the air as if stirring it. The sea is split down the middle: the left half a flat, glassy, ink-blue calm with evenly spaced buoys in ruled rows; the right half wild water, foam and storm-violet cloud. Wide composition: the boat right of centre on the seam; the upper left third is calm, empty dawn sky, left clear. Low dawn-gold light from the left on the wave crest. Palette: ink-blue, sea-green, foam white, storm violet, dawn gold. His face is not shown; no trident, no crown, no halo, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: The Charter: a calm lane, and wild water beyond it
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Dawn over a quiet crescent bay. A broad wooden ferry crosses one glassy, ink-blue lane of perfectly calm water, its small crew standing together on deck, heads lifted as if singing; just beyond the lane the open sea rises and falls on its own in sea-green swells and foam. At the tideline in the middle distance, small and seen from behind, stand a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers, and beside him a young woman in her twenties with long dark hair and a pale dress stained with sand and salt, holding a thick sheaf of pages whose last sheet hangs longest. Dawn-gold light from the low left. Palette: dawn gold, ink-blue, sea-green, foam white. The lower quarter of the frame is smooth wet sand, empty and calm. No faces shown, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: No Lord: an ordinary man rowing in at dawn
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Dawn on an ordinary sea, neither glassy nor stormy, small grey-green waves, very wide shot from far back and high up. Small in the centre of the frame, a little wooden rowing boat seen from behind, a middle-aged sailor with short grey hair in a clean faded linen shirt seated rowing toward shore, both oars out, his face unseen; the boat and man occupy only a small part of the middle of the picture. Far off a small single-masted fishing boat rides at anchor with a few tiny figures aboard, and on the headland a white lamp tower stands dark and unlit, its buoys drifting out of line. Soft dawn-gold light from the low left, thin mist, nothing uncanny: he is only a man. Palette: dawn gold, tea brown, muted sea-green, foam white. The whole lower third of the frame is plain empty open water with only tiny ripples, no boat, no oars. No stains, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: The Wild Sea: the storm he made, and the moorings lifting
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. A storm at sea under storm-violet cloud, a torn seam of dawn gold at the horizon. The whole of an old single-masted wooden sailing boat is visible in three-quarter rear view, bow rising on a great sea-green wave, its long bowsprit pointing into the storm; a small human-sized sailor, barefoot, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark trousers, seen from behind, stands on the bowsprit with one arm raised, tiny against the waves, a faint sea-green rim of light on his shoulders. Foam climbs around the bow. Along the bottom of the frame runs a low dark strip of harbour coast: stone quays, small moored boats lifting on their lines, lamps guttering, and one small woman in a pale dress walking away along the quay with her back to the sea. Driving rain. Palette: storm violet, sea-green, foam white, dawn gold. The lower quarter stays dark and quiet. No trident, no crown, no wreckage, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: Mostly fixed: he is now a man-sized figure on the bowsprit, seen from behind, with the woman on the quay. The ship is a large two-masted carrack, not the single-masted boat asked for, and the lower quarter holds quay stonework rather than dark calm.

images.title: The Lord's Peace: he stirs the water, and it does nothing
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Flat white noon on a clean sandy beach, almost no shadows. a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers stands ankle-deep at the water's edge, seen from behind, head lowered; one hand turns a glass bottle, the other trails in the water at his ankles, stirring. The water does not answer: the sea is one sheet of ink-blue glass to the horizon, without a ripple or a line of foam. Across it, identical buoys with small bells stand at exactly even intervals in ruled rows, and a tidy white trading port sits too clean on the far shore. Flat lamp-white light from directly above. Palette: ink-blue, lamp white, tea brown, a little ledger red on the buoys. The lower quarter is pale, empty sand. His face is not shown, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: Paid in Kind: all he asked for was a ripple
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Dawn at the tideline of a quiet bay, beside a standing stone at the left. An older sailor with short grey hair and a grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers, kneels upright on the wet sand at the water's edge, seen from behind in natural proportions, head and grey hair clearly visible, shoulders level, one hand reaching down with a single finger in the shallows; a single small ring of ripples spreads from it and nothing more. Beside him eight small scraps of blank pale paper float in the foam, their faint ink dissolving in sea-green threads. Out in the bay a white lamp tower still burns and a row of evenly spaced buoys still stands; beyond them the open water heaves wild, sea-green under storm-violet cloud. Dawn-gold light from the low left. Palette: dawn gold, sea-green, foam white, ink-blue. The lower quarter is smooth empty pale wet sand with nothing on it. No halo, no glow, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: Mostly fixed: older grey-haired man, blank paper, empty lower quarter. His head is turned in near profile so part of his bearded face shows, the stone is on the left and the buoys read as posts on a pier by the tower, and the paper floats in the surf rather than around his feet.
